datasets.name: f5da4429
queryLines:
with job_runs AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('QUARTER', period_end_time) as usage_quarter,
    date_trunc('MONTH', period_end_time) as usage_month,
    date_trunc('WEEK', period_end_time) as usage_week,
    date_trunc('DAY', period_end_time) as usage_day,
    t1.*
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t1 left JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
  WHERE
    (period_end_time BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date)
    AND IF(:param_workspace = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, workspace_name = :param_workspace)
)
SELECT
  identifier(
    case
      when :param_time_key = 'Quarter' then 'usage_quarter'
      when :param_time_key = 'Month' then 'usage_month'
      when :param_time_key = 'Week' then 'usage_week'
      when :param_time_key = 'Day' then 'usage_day'
      else 'usage_day'
    end
  ) as time_key,
  *
FROM
  job_runs

datasets.name: 3b209ef5
queryLines: with usage_with_cost as ( SELECT t1.*, t1.identity_metadata.run_as, t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default as list_cost FROM system.billing.usage t1 INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time and ( t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time or list_prices.price_end_time is null ) WHERE (t1.usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date) AND if(:param_workspace = '', true, workspace_id = :param_workspace) ), most_recent_jobs as ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) as rn FROM system.lakeflow.jobs WHERE if(:param_workspace = '', true, workspace_id = :param_workspace) QUALIFY rn = 1 ), job_run_timeline_with_cost as ( SELECT t1.*, t2.job_id, t2.run_id, t2.result_state FROM usage_with_cost t1 INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2 ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time) AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR ), cumulative_run_status_cost as ( SELECT *, SUM(list_cost) OVER ( ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_cost FROM job_run_timeline_with_cost ), cost_per_status as ( SELECT *, cumulative_cost - COALESCE( LAG(cumulative_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time), 0 ) AS result_state_cost FROM cumulative_run_status_cost WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL ), cost_per_status_agg as ( SELECT workspace_id, job_id, first(run_as, TRUE) as run_as, SUM(result_state_cost) as list_cost FROM cost_per_status WHERE result_state IN ('ERROR', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') GROUP BY ALL ), terminal_statues as ( SELECT workspace_id, job_id, CASE WHEN result_state IN ('ERROR', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_failure, period_end_time as last_seen_date FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL AND period_end_time >= :param_start_date ), output AS ( SELECT first(t2.name, true) as name, t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, COUNT(*) as runs, coalesce(FIRST(t3.run_as, true), FIRST(t2.run_as, true)) as run_as, SUM(is_failure) as failures, (1 - COALESCE(try_divide(SUM(is_failure), COUNT(*)), 0)) * 100 as success_ratio, first(t3.list_cost) as failure_list_cost, MAX(t1.last_seen_date) as last_seen_date FROM terminal_statues t1 LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id) LEFT JOIN cost_per_status_agg t3 USING (workspace_id, job_id) GROUP BY ALL HAVING (failure_list_cost > :param_min_usage) OR ( :param_include_all = 'Yes' AND failure_list_cost IS NULL ) ORDER BY failures DESC ) SELECT coalesce( CONCAT("", t2.workspace_name, ""), t1.workspace_id ) as workspace, coalesce( CONCAT( "", COALESCE(t1.name, t1.job_id), "" ) ) as entity_url, * FROM output t1 LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id) ORDER BY failures DESC

queryLines: with usage_with_cost as ( SELECT t1.*, t1.identity_metadata.run_as, t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default as list_cost FROM system.billing.usage t1 INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time and ( t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time or list_prices.price_end_time is null ) WHERE (t1.usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date) ), most_recent_jobs as ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) as rn FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY rn = 1 ), job_run_timeline_with_cost as ( SELECT t1.*, t2.job_id, t2.run_id, t2.result_state FROM usage_with_cost t1 INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2 ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time) AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR ), cumulative_run_status_cost as ( SELECT *, SUM(list_cost) OVER ( ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_cost FROM job_run_timeline_with_cost ), cost_per_status as ( SELECT *, cumulative_cost - COALESCE( LAG(cumulative_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time), 0 ) AS result_state_cost FROM cumulative_run_status_cost WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL ), cost_per_unsuccesful_status_agg as ( SELECT workspace_id, job_id, run_id, first(run_as, TRUE) as run_as, SUM(result_state_cost) as list_cost FROM cost_per_status WHERE result_state != "SUCCEEDED" GROUP BY ALL ), repaired_runs as ( SELECT workspace_id, job_id, run_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL HAVING cnt > 1 ), successful_repairs as ( SELECT t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, t1.run_id, MAX(t1.period_end_time) as period_end_time FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t1 JOIN repaired_runs t2 ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id AND t1.job_id = t2.job_id AND t1.run_id = t2.run_id WHERE t1.result_state = "SUCCEEDED" GROUP BY ALL ), combined_repairs as ( SELECT t1.*, t2.period_end_time, t1.cnt as repairs FROM repaired_runs t1 LEFT JOIN successful_repairs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id) ), output as ( SELECT last(t3.name) as name, t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, t1.run_id, coalesce(FIRST(t4.run_as, true), FIRST(t3.run_as, TRUE)) as run_as, first(t1.repairs) - 1 as repairs, first(t4.list_cost) as repair_list_cost, CASE WHEN t1.period_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t1.period_end_time - MIN(t2.period_end_time) as LONG) ELSE NULL END AS repair_time_seconds FROM combined_repairs t1 JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id) LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t3 USING (workspace_id, job_id) LEFT JOIN cost_per_unsuccesful_status_agg t4 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id) WHERE t2.result_state IS NOT NULL AND t1.repairs > 2 GROUP BY t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, t1.run_id, t1.period_end_time HAVING (repair_list_cost > :param_min_usage) OR ( :param_include_all = 'Yes' AND repair_list_cost IS NULL ) ORDER BY repair_list_cost, repairs DESC ) SELECT coalesce( CONCAT("", t2.workspace_name, ""), t1.workspace_id ) as workspace, coalesce( CONCAT( "", COALESCE(t1.name, t1.job_id), "" ) ) as entity_url, * FROM output t1 LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id) WHERE if(:param_workspace = '', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace) ORDER BY repair_list_cost, repairs DESC

datasets.name: 5b65e781
queryLines: -- SPENDING BROKEN DOWN BY JOB with most_recent_jobs as ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) as rn FROM system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY rn = 1 ), stats_per_job_run as ( SELECT t1.workspace_id, t1.usage_metadata.job_id, t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id as run_id, FIRST(t1.identity_metadata.run_as, TRUE) as run_as, SUM(t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default) as list_cost, first(t1.custom_tags, true) as custom_tags, MAX(t1.usage_end_time) as last_seen, MIN(t1.usage_start_time) as first_seen FROM system.billing.usage t1 INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time and ( t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time or list_prices.price_end_time is null ) WHERE t1.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id IS NOT NULL AND (t1.usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), stats_per_job AS ( SELECT t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, coalesce(FIRST(t1.run_as, TRUE), FIRST(t2.run_as, TRUE)) as run_as, FIRST(t2.name, TRUE) as name, COUNT(run_id) AS runs, SUM(list_cost) AS total_list_cost, AVG(list_cost) AS avg_list_cost, MAX(list_cost) AS max_list_cost, percentile(list_cost, 0.9) AS p90 FROM stats_per_job_run t1 LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id) WHERE first_seen > :param_start_date GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY total_list_cost DESC ), output as ( SELECT *, (max_list_cost - p90) AS list_cost_deviation_from_p90 FROM stats_per_job ORDER BY list_cost_deviation_from_p90 DESC ) SELECT coalesce( CONCAT("", t2.workspace_name, ""), t1.workspace_id ) as workspace, coalesce( CONCAT( "", COALESCE(t1.name, t1.job_id), "" ) ) as entity_url, * FROM output t1 LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id) WHERE if(:param_workspace = '', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace)

datasets.name: 6a28dc41
queryLines:
with usage_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t1.identity_metadata.run_as,
    t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default as list_cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage t1
      INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices
        on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud
        and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name
        and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time
        and (
          t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time
          or list_prices.price_end_time is null
        )
  WHERE
    (t1.usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date)
),
job_run_timeline_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t2.job_id,
    t2.run_id,
    t2.result_state
  FROM
    usage_with_cost t1
      INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2
        ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id
        AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time)
        AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
),
status_boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    run_id,
    result_state,
    usage_start_time,
    usage_end_time,
    LAG(usage_end_time) OVER (
        PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id
        ORDER BY usage_start_time
      ) as prev_status_time
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_cost
  WHERE
    result_state IS NOT NULL
),
costs_by_status AS (
  SELECT
    t.workspace_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.run_id,
    sb.result_state,
    MIN(t.usage_start_time) as min_start_time,
    SUM(t.list_cost) as list_cost
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_cost t
      JOIN status_boundaries sb
        ON t.workspace_id = sb.workspace_id
        AND t.job_id = sb.job_id
        AND t.run_id = sb.run_id
        AND t.usage_start_time > COALESCE(sb.prev_status_time, CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 999 DAYS)
        AND t.usage_start_time <= sb.usage_end_time
  GROUP BY
    t.workspace_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.run_id,
    sb.result_state
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  costs_by_status t1 LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
WHERE
  if(:param_workspace = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace)
  and result_state IN ('ERROR', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT');
